say:2:1041504501:1.text: It's been a long time since I last saw a fairy. I don't even remember when the last time was.
say:2:1041504501:1.source_cn: 我已经很久没有见到过妖精了……上一次，是什么时候来着？

say:3:1041504502:1.text: ...It happened in the morning when you were picking flowers for the captain's appointment ceremony!
say:3:1041504502:1.source_cn: ……是你特意起了个大早去摘花，给荆棘队长授职仪式做准备...

say:4:1041504503:1.text: Oh? Right... How come you know it so well?
say:4:1041504503:1.source_cn: 哦？哦……对。奇怪，你怎么知道？

say:5:1041504504:1.text: Hee-hee! Let me introduce myself first—I'm Tasi, the fairy of dreams. I enjoy spending time in the dreamland.
say:5:1041504504:1.source_cn: 这个嘛……嘻嘻！正式介绍一下，我是塔西，是一名梦守妖精...

say:6:1041504505:1.text: I wandered into your dream some time ago, meaning we've known each other far longer than you think.
say:6:1041504505:1.source_cn: 说不准什么时候，我路过了你的梦境，所以我们认识的时候，...

say:7:1041504506:1.text: I see... Don't you feel lonely?
say:7:1041504506:1.source_cn: 啊……这样说起来，你不会感觉到孤单吗……？

say:8:1041504507:1.text: After all, most people forget about their dreams as soon as they wake up, and only you remember what happened.
say:8:1041504507:1.source_cn: 毕竟大多数人醒来就把梦忘得一干二净，只有你保留着在梦里...

say:9:1041504508:1.text: That's so sweet of you! You're as thoughtful and caring as you are in your dreams.
say:9:1041504508:1.source_cn: 哇……你好温柔啊，果然像你的梦境一样，是个细腻体贴的人呢。

say:10:1041504509:1.text: I don't remember any of my dreams. Could you tell me about them?
say:10:1041504509:1.source_cn: 我记不清自己做过什么样的梦，你可以和我说说吗？

say:11:1041504510:1.text: Ah, here comes my favorite thing to do!
say:11:1041504510:1.source_cn: 哎呀呀，又到我最喜欢的环节了！

say:12:1041504511:1.text: Making people curious about their dreams first, revealing the exciting details to them, and then waiting for changes to happen in their dreams... I can never get enough of this game!
say:12:1041504511:1.source_cn: 用别人梦里精彩的经历来勾起他们的好奇心，再逐个揭露，等...

say:13:1041504512:1.text: Hehe... You make me want to visit my own dreams!
say:13:1041504512:1.source_cn: 呵呵……听你说的，我都想亲自去我的梦里瞧瞧了。

say:14:1041504513:1.text: Speaking of which, I'm already looking forward to our next adventure in the dream!
say:14:1041504513:1.source_cn: 说到这里，我已经开始期待我们下一次梦中冒险了！

say:15:1041504514:1.text: Could you tell me about my last dream?
say:15:1041504514:1.source_cn: 那么，可以告诉我，我上一次的梦境是什么样的吗？

say:16:1041504515:1.text: No problem! Trust me, your dreams are far beyond your imagination, Parisa.
say:16:1041504515:1.source_cn: 当然，我可以肯定地说……帕瑞莎，你的梦境远超过你的想象。

say:17:1041504516:1.text: Last time, I witnessed you defeating the people of the Adamant Syndicate with your staff and purifying all corruptions in the Dark Forest...
say:17:1041504516:1.source_cn: 上次，我见到你挥动法杖击倒了黑金商会的人，还亲手净化了...

say:18:1041504517:1.text: Even Eomir knelt before you and declared, "Queen of the Dark Forest, I'm pledging my loyalty to you..."
say:18:1041504517:1.source_cn: 就连伊米尔那个家伙都跪在你脚下，高喊着“薄暮丛林的女王...

say:19:1041504518:1.text: R-really?! I did that in my dream?
say:19:1041504518:1.source_cn: ……真、真的吗？！这是我梦里做出来的事？

say:20:1041504519:1.text: Parisa, you're actually much stronger than you think.
say:20:1041504519:1.source_cn: 帕瑞莎，你的梦境远超过你的想象。这句话的意思是——你远...

say:21:1041504520:1.text: Is that so... But in reality, I'm just a loser who wastes my time drinking in the flower field...
say:21:1041504520:1.source_cn: 是吗……明明现实里，我什么都不敢做，只敢浑浑噩噩地醉倒...

say:22:1041504521:1.text: But you never lack the courage to stand up for yourself—I can tell from your dreams.
say:22:1041504521:1.source_cn: 但你从来不缺乏抗争的勇气——这是梦境告诉我的。

say:23:1041504522:1.text: Thanks... Thank you so much, lovely little one.
say:23:1041504522:1.source_cn: 多谢……多谢你了，温柔的小家伙。

say:24:1041504523:1.text: You must have seen my dark side in my dreams, but your clever and gentle storytelling comforts my guilt-ridden soul.
say:24:1041504523:1.source_cn: 我想你应该在我的梦境里看到了更多黑暗的东西，但你用聪明...

say:25:1041504524:1.text: It's my pleasure to meet you. You're welcome to visit my dreams again!
say:25:1041504524:1.source_cn: 很高兴认识你，欢迎你再来我的梦境里玩。
